notices.html: Hot weekend ahead: heat index near 100°F is expected Saturday. Plan outdoor picking and festivals for the morning, bring extra water, and take shade breaks.

blurbs.terhune: This weekend: blueberries are pick-your-own through the summer, but there's still no cherries or peaches (the spring freeze wiped out the stone fruit). Terhune's Summer Fest takes over the farm Aug 1 and 2, 10am to 5pm, with pony rides, a traveling zoo, giant bubble shows and a new craft fair, so expect a crowd. Store and donuts open 9 to 6, no pets; call 609-924-2310 to confirm the day's picking.
blurbs.vonthun: This weekend: blueberry season has wrapped at the South Brunswick fields, but blackberries are now pick-your-own. Call 732-329-8656 to confirm before you drive over. Farm market and donuts open daily.
blurbs.hickory: This weekend: no confirmed 2026 crop update found online for this small, diversified farm. Early August usually brings blackberries, nectarines, corn and tomatoes. Call 609-448-0629 for the day's pick, open 9 to 6, Sundays 2 to 6, arrive by 5:15pm to enter the fields.
blurbs.hollandridge: Nothing to pick this weekend. The fall Sunflower Festival runs September 10 to October 12, timed tickets around $17 on weekends; keep an eye on hollandridgefarms.com for the on-sale date.
blurbs.locusthall: This weekend: blackberries are self-serve picking (the season runs into mid-August), along with flowers. A hayride carries you out to the fields; open Thursday to Sunday, 9am to 5pm. Call 609-353-9000 to confirm before heading over.
blurbs.johnsonscorner: This weekend: blueberries are wrapping up for the season while blackberries, new this year, are pickable. Hayrides, animals and soft-serve stay open. Picking dates can shift by a week or more, so call the Pick Your Own Hotline 609-654-5894 to confirm.
blurbs.battleview: This weekend: the spring freeze wiped out cherries, peaches, nectarines and apples this year, so no stone-fruit or apple picking is expected all season. Bakery and store stay open; call 732-462-0756 to confirm what's on hand.
blurbs.norzhill: This weekend: no confirmed u-pick crop found online, but the 5-acre Sunflower Path is open for peak bloom, about $10pp with kids under 36in free. Call 908-371-2697 to confirm hours before heading over.
blurbs.alstede: This weekend: blueberries are in their last stretch of the season alongside other summer crops. Field admission runs about $5.99 to $6.99pp depending on the day (free Mon to Thu before 11am) and includes wagon rides and the sunflower trail. A 60-minute drive, so check their site's daily picking list or call first.
blurbs.howell: This Saturday: Honey Harvest, 11am hive opening and 1pm honey extraction, free. Closed Sunday as usual.
